title: Engenheiro de Dados Senior
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Requisitos

Conhecimento Técnico

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de fluxos de dados (Ex: Nifi, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue ETL)

• Conhecimento em Python e SQL

• Conhecimento em modelagem de dados

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de transformação de dados (Ex: dbt, EMR, Databricks)

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração de pipelines (Ex: Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Degster)

• Proficiência em bancos de dados relacionais (Ex: SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL).

• Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e comunicar-se efetivamente em inglês.

• Capacidade de aprender e seguir padrões de trabalho (Agile)

• Capacidade de identificar problemas e sugerir soluções.


Responsabilidade

• Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados para a ingestão, limpeza e transformação de dados.

• Coletar, limpar e transformar dados brutos em formatos utilizáveis para análise.

• Modelar e utilizar bancos de dados relacionais (SQL), e data warehouses.

• Colaborar com analistas de dados para fornecer datasets refinados.


E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Social Seller
description:
OPORTUNIDADE: SOCIAL SELLER (Remoto)


Transforme conexões em vendas reais no mercado digital

Você é apaixonado por redes sociais, sabe se conectar com pessoas de forma genuína e possui habilidade para transformar conversas em vendas?

Busca crescimento rápido, gosta de desafios e quer atuar ao lado de grandes experts do mercado digital?

Então essa vaga é para você.



Sobre a RedSuit

Na RedSuit, acreditamos que toda venda começa com um relacionamento verdadeiro.

Somos especialistas em potencializar resultados por meio de estratégias modernas de Social Selling — e agora buscamos alguém com energia, foco e vontade de crescer para integrar nosso time.


O que faz um Social Seller?

O Social Seller é responsável por conduzir vendas sociais por meio de interações estratégicas nas redes (Instagram, LinkedIn e outros canais).

Na prática, você atuará como um “clone digital” do expert, construindo relações, nutrindo leads e convertendo seguidores em clientes.


Responsabilidades Principais
  • Dar boas-vindas e engajar novos seguidores via Direct do Instagram
  • Construir e nutrir relacionamentos com leads qualificados
  • Fechar vendas diretamente ou agendar reuniões para Closers/Experts
  • Registrar e acompanhar todas as interações no CRM (Kommo)
  • Realizar follow-ups estratégicos para maximizar conversões
  • Gerar relatórios diários de performance e indicadores
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e estratégia



O que esperamos de você
  • Experiência prévia em vendas — preferencialmente no digital (infoprodutos, mentorias, lançamentos)
  • Excelente comunicação: clara, empática e persuasiva
  • Organização e disciplina para gerenciar múltiplos leads simultaneamente
  • Foco em metas, mentalidade de crescimento e resiliência
  • Equipamentos adequados para trabalho remoto (PC/Laptop + celular)



O que oferecemos

Salário fixo + comissões agressivas (ganhe proporcional à sua performance)

Treinamento personalizado com nosso Head de Vendas

title: Cientista de Dados Sênior (Prevenção a Fraudes)
description:
Um pouco sobre nós:


A TotalPass é uma empresa que oferece benefícios corporativos para o bem estar, proporcionando acesso à diversos serviços como academias, estúdios especializados em corrida, boxe, yoga, ciclismo, treinos funcionais coletivos e desenvolvimento muscular. Temos prazer em descomplicar a vida dos nossos clientes com as nossas soluções e fazemos isso de uma forma colaborativa, em um ambiente desafiador.

Acreditamos que o bem-estar existe quando olhamos para a saúde física e mental de maneira leve, livre e integral, e ampliamos diariamente nosso olhar para entender diferentes frentes de saúde agindo juntas. Tudo isso para que as pessoas se sintam seguras em um ambiente onde é possível equilibrar o físico e o mental, de acordo com as possibilidades de suas próprias rotinas.


O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de um Cientista de Dados Sênior para se juntar ao nosso time de Prevenção a fraudes. Será um profissional experiente, apaixonado por descobrir padrões e insights a partir de grandes volumes de dados que gerem valor para o negócio.


Como é o time de Prevenção e Fraude?


O time de Prevenção e Fraude da TotalPass é composto por profissionais altamente qualificados e dedicados a proteger nossos clientes e nossos negócios contra atividades fraudulentas. Trabalhamos de forma colaborativa, utilizando tecnologias de ponta e metodologias avançadas para identificar, analisar e mitigar riscos de fraude. Nosso time é movido por desafios e está constantemente em busca de novas formas de melhorar a segurança e a eficiência de nossas operações.


Como será o seu dia a dia?


  • Desenvolver e implementar modelos estatísticos e algoritmos de machine learning para prever e detectar padrões de fraude com alto grau de precisão e escalabilidade;
  • Desenvolver e implementar segmentações comportamentais baseada em técnicas estatísticas;
  • Construir modelos preditivos que identificam anomalias, comportamentos suspeitos e tendências de fraude com base em dados históricos e em tempo real;
  • Atuar na melhoria contínua dos modelos;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências e evoluções na área de prevenção a fraudes e implementar as melhores práticas.


Requisitos:


  • Vasta atuação em Data Science e Machine Learning;
  • Experiência em lidar com grandes volumes de dados e em manipulação de dados em ambientes de nuvem, preferencialmente AWS;
  • Proficiência em linguagens de programação como Python, SQL, e experiência com frameworks de Machine Learning;
  • Visão de negócio para entender a necessidade do produto e traduzir em uma solução estratégica utilizando estatística ou métodos matemáticos;
  • Capacidade de se comunicar de forma colaborativa;


Quais seriam seus diferenciais:


  • Experiência prévia em áreas de Estratégia de Prevenção a Fraudes;
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis e experiência em trabalhar em ambientes ágeis;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de painéis de visualização de dados utilizando ferramentas como: Quicksight, Data Viz,Tableau ou PowerBI;


Formação acadêmica:


Superior completo em Estatística, Matemática, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas relacionadas.


O que oferecemos?


  • Regime de contratação CLT;
  • Assistência Médica | Bradesco Saúde;
  • Assistência Odontológica | Amil Saúde;
  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação | Swile Benefícios Flexíveis;
  • Plano TP6 TotalPass (+ inclusão de 10 dependentes) | Acesso aos serviços incluindo as academias do grupo Bio Ritmo, Smartfit e Queima Diária;
  • TP Clube | Clube de descontos com marcas incríveis;
  • Serviço de Saúde Mental | Parceria Psicologia Viva e Zen;
  • Horário de trabalho flexível | Modelo Remoto;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Total Learn (reembolso para cursos rápidos, livros e cursos de idiomas);
  • Descontos em universidades parceiras (Graduação, Pós, MBA);
  • Day off no aniversário;
  • Bônus Semestral;
  • Auxílio Creche.

O time de Prevenção e Fraude da TotalPass é composto por profissionais altamente qualificados e dedicados a proteger nossos clientes e nossos negócios contra atividades fraudulentas. Trabalhamos de forma colaborativa, utilizando tecnologias de ponta e metodologias avançadas para identificar, analisar e mitigar riscos de fraude. Nosso time é movido por desafios e está constantemente em busca de novas formas de melhorar a segurança e a eficiência de nossas operações.


Como será o seu dia a dia?


  • Desenvolver e implementar modelos estatísticos e algoritmos de machine learning para prever e detectar padrões de fraude com alto grau de precisão e escalabilidade;
  • Desenvolver e implementar segmentações comportamentais baseada em técnicas estatísticas;
  • Construir modelos preditivos que identificam anomalias, comportamentos suspeitos e tendências de fraude com base em dados históricos e em tempo real;
  • Atuar na melhoria contínua dos modelos;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências e evoluções na área de prevenção a fraudes e implementar as melhores práticas.


Requisitos:


  • Vasta atuação em Data Science e Machine Learning;
  • Experiência em lidar com grandes volumes de dados e em manipulação de dados em ambientes de nuvem, preferencialmente AWS;
  • Proficiência em linguagens de programação como Python, SQL, e experiência com frameworks de Machine Learning;
  • Visão de negócio para entender a necessidade do produto e traduzir em uma solução estratégica utilizando estatística ou métodos matemáticos;
  • Capacidade de se comunicar de forma colaborativa;


Quais seriam seus diferenciais:


  • Experiência prévia em áreas de Estratégia de Prevenção a Fraudes;
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis e experiência em trabalhar em ambientes ágeis;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de painéis de visualização de dados utilizando ferramentas como: Quicksight, Data Viz,Tableau ou PowerBI;


Formação acadêmica:


Superior completo em Estatística, Matemática, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas relacionadas.


O que oferecemos?


  • Regime de contratação CLT;
  • Assistência Médica | Bradesco Saúde;
  • Assistência Odontológica | Amil Saúde;
  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação | Swile Benefícios Flexíveis;
  • Plano TP6 TotalPass (+ inclusão de 10 dependentes) | Acesso aos serviços incluindo as academias do grupo Bio Ritmo, Smartfit e Queima Diária;
  • TP Clube | Clube de descontos com marcas incríveis;
  • Serviço de Saúde Mental | Parceria Psicologia Viva e Zen;
  • Horário de trabalho flexível | Modelo Remoto;

  • Descontos em universidades parceiras (Graduação, Pós, MBA);

  • Auxílio Creche.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Position: Data Engineer

Location: Remote in Brazil

Duration: 3 year+ PJ Contract

Monthly Salary Range: 3-5k USD/Month


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering
  • Hands on data engineering experience with Microsoft Fabric (highly preferred) or Azure Synapse/Databricks are also acceptable
  • Advanced Data Manipulation experience using SQL, Pandas, and PySpark
  • Proficiency in Azure Data Services such as: Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Data Factory, or Azure SQL Databases


Nice to Have:

  • Exposure to Azure AI Services (AI Foundry, AI Search, Document Intelligence).
  • Experience in Data Science & Machine Learning:
  • Python, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, MLFlow, EDA.
  • Familiarity with LLMs and related frameworks:
  • OpenAI, Prompt Engineering, LangChain.


Day to day –

We are seeking 2 experienced Data Engineers to support a large-scale ERP implementation for one of our hardware manufacturing clients. The ideal candidate will design, build, and optimize data pipelines and architectures to ensure seamless integration and transformation of enterprise data. This role requires strong technical expertise in modern data platforms, Azure services, and data modeling principles.


Key Duties and Responsibilities –

  • Design and implement scalable data pipelines for ERP integration.
  • Develop and maintain data models aligned with ERP requirements.
  • Optimize data storage and retrieval using Azure services.
  • Collaborate with ERP functional teams to ensure accurate data migration and transformation.
  • Implement best practices for Data Architecture, Data Warehouse design, and Master Data Management.
  • Support Azure infrastructure and troubleshoot data-related issues.
  • Ensure compliance with data governance and security standards.

description:

Step Labs is a web development and design agency specializing in driving revenue growth for 7 to 8 figure e-commerce brands. By partnering with ambitious founders, Step Labs creates tailored revenue growth systems to efficiently scale businesses. This is a full-time remote role for a Social Media Marketing Specialist.   • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Knowledge of performance analytics tools for tracking campaign outcomes
  • Familiarity with e-commerce marketing is a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field is preferred

title: SAP Mobile Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Work as part of SAP Empowered Product Teams, design, develop, and maintain frontend application features for cross platform mobile SAP Service and Asset Manager.

Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of standard and SAP mobile technology in development and testing, such as SAP BTP Mobile Services, SAP Mobile Development Kit, JavaScript, TypeScript, Visual Studio Code, Xcode, Android Studio, ilodata, SQL, Ultralite DB, Appium, Java, SAP Business Application Studio, Github, CI/CD with Hyperspace Fastlane, OData Services, SAP Gateway, S/4HANA system etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, feature requirement

Actively collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines for each platform, iOS, Android and Windows, and figma design for the application.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features

Actively collaborate with backend integration service developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration in frontend logic

Use S/4HANA system and its relevant business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), and data objects (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), setup necessary test data in S/4HANA system, perform end-to-end test, and validate developed features against S/4HANA system.

Conduct thorough testing, including unit testing, integration test, and UI automation test scripts for developed features

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, crashes, and performance issues

Provide sufficient documentations on features developed

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates

Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from ServiceNow. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in ServicewNow incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.

Maintain communication and documentation in English

Maintain proper communication and notification with lead MDK developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Analista de Projetos (Pl/Sr)
description:
Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!

Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.

Estamos presentes em +20 Países e, dentre os nossos Clientes, estão os 8 Bancos mais importantes do Brasil e os 20 da América Latina!

São +80.000 terminais de autoatendimento; +1.000.000 autenticações de transações de compras eletrônicas ao mês; +800.000 cartões bancários com chip disponibilizados ao mês em lojas e agências bancárias; e até em 2024, foram +100 bancos utilizando nossos sistemas de emissor que permitem a tokenização de cartões COF (Card on File) e eCommerce. Isso é só uma parte dos nossos resultados, mas também é só começo!

Nos bastidores de todas as nossas conquistas está o nosso Time, que conta com +200 Pessoas envolvidas no desenvolvimento das nossas soluções. Pessoas questionadoras, curiosas, criativas, proativas, colaborativas e abertas a novas experiências!


Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:


Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Projetos para se unir ao nosso Time de Projects para:

  • Participação de reuniões internas e externas com clientes;
  • Organização das demandas de projetos de acordo o processo definido, com boas práticas do PMBOK e metodologias ágeis;
  • Gerenciamento de solicitações e atividades não previstas em projetos;
  • Realização de atividades operacionais de gestão de projetos;
  • Gerenciamento de contas de projetos de clientes nacionais e internacionais;
  • Acompanhamento de reuniões e atividades de marcos de projetos;
  • Acompanhamento KPIs de projetos;
  • Asseguração da conformidade com padrões e procedimentos internos;
  • Facilitação da comunicação com Stakeholders;
  • Condução de revisões periódicas de projetos;
  • Gerenciamento e planejamento de marcos de faturamento (garantia de receita);
  • Treinamento e suporte à equipe de projetos (exclusivo - Senior)


Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:

  • Formação completa em TI ou área relacionada;
  • Experiência de ao menos um ano (Pleno)/ dois anos (Senior) atuando como líder de projetos em contato direto com clientes;
  • Conhecimento sólido em MS Projects, Excel, Cronogramas;
  • Conhecimentos de PMBOK/Scrum/Kanban;
  • Espanhol avançado.


Será um grande diferencial se:

  • Conhecimento em Jira;
  • Conhecimento em Power BI;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Conhecimento com produtos ou com conceitos relacionados a meios de pagamento.


O que oferecemos?

A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !

  • Contratação em regime CLT;
  • Atuação 100% Remota
  • Horário flexível;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento, através do contínuo desenvolvimento, tanto técnico quanto pessoal;
  • Temos programas de desenvolvimento destinado às novas lideranças;
  • 10% das horas mensais, podem ser dedicadas para aprender algo novo;
  • Day-Off no mês do aniversário;
  • Ajuda de Custo Home Office;
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Ampliadas;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • WellHub (antiga Gympass);
  • Convênio médico;
  • Convênio odontológico;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição;
  • Vale Transporte ou estacionamento;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Seguro de Vida.


Prezamos por um bom ambiente de trabalho que contribua para as pessoas evoluírem e se sentirem acolhidas, livres, autênticas e à vontade para demonstrarem suas habilidades! Apoiamos a diversidade e não temos espaço para qualquer tipo de discriminação!

title: React Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


Join our dynamic Team as a React Developer and drive innovation in a collaborative environment. You'll enhance services, tools, and components within a collaborative Team by driving Agile solutions for internal and external challenges, ensuring top-notch software quality. Become a key player in our Core team, utilizing modern technologies to shape artifacts and support diverse groups, all while ensuring our software reaches new heights of excellence.


Key responsibilities:


- Develop high-quality, maintainable, and scalable user interface components using React.js.

- Work closely with the product and design teams to achieve effective UX.

- Collaborate with other developers on tasks related to front-end and back-end services.

- Conduct performance optimization of applications for maximum speed and scalability.

- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the latest React frameworks and libraries.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience in React.

- Experience with Typescript.

- Familiarity with caching systems.

- Comfortable working in GMT+2 timezone.

- Fluent Spanish level.

- Intermediate English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Desenvolvedor ServiceNow – Especialista em SPM (Change Velocity)
description:
A ADOX Tech continua acelerando sua expansão e ampliando a entrega de projetos

estratégicos que conectam tecnologia, governança e resultados. Para fortalecer nosso time,

buscamos um Desenvolvedor ServiceNow com experiência sólida em SPM (Strategic

Portfolio Management) e profundo domínio em Change Velocity / DevOps Change

Velocity.


Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver, configurar e evoluir soluções no módulo SPM, com foco em Change Velocity, Demand, Project, Portfolio e Resource Management.
  • Implementar fluxos e automações para avaliação, priorização, aprovação e monitoramento de demandas e projetos.
  • Criar dashboards, relatórios executivos e métricas avançadas de fluxo (lead time, throughput, WIP, capacidade).
  • Integrar o ServiceNow com ferramentas DevOps e de gestão de projetos (Jenkins, Git, Azure DevOps, Jira).
  • Automatizar pipelines, orquestrar mudanças e garantir visibilidade ponta a ponta do ciclo de entrega.
  • Sustentar e evoluir a solução com foco em governança, performance e boas práticas ServiceNow.


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência comprovada (mínimo 2 anos) com o módulo DevOps Change Velocity do ServiceNow.
  • Vivência prática com os módulos SPM, Change Velocity, automações e integrações DevOps.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em: JavaScript, GlideScript e AngularJS, Flow Designer, Integration Hub, Business Rules, UI Pages, MID Server, REST/SOAP APIs, autenticação OAuth, SSO, Data Source
  • Experiência com ITSM (Incident, Problem, Change), ITIL e automação de pipelines.
  • Integrações com Jenkins, Git, Azure DevOps, Jira e demais ferramentas de entrega contínua.


Diferenciais


  • Certificações ServiceNow (CSA, CIS-SPM, CIS-DevOps, CAD).
  • Experiência com Agile 2.0, OKRs, roadmapping e governança de portfólio.
  • Conhecimento avançado em integrações com ferramentas modernas de desenvolvimento e gestão ágil.
  • Atuação prévia em projetos corporativos de grande porte.


O que oferecemos


  • Participação em projetos estratégicos e iniciativas de alto impacto.
  • Ambiente colaborativo, orientado à especialização e à inovação na plataforma ServiceNow.
  • Oportunidades reais de crescimento em uma consultoria referência em ServiceNow no Brasil.

title: Desenvolvedor ServiceNow – Especialista em SPM (Change Velocity)
description:
A ADOX Tech continua acelerando sua expansão e ampliando a entrega de projetos

estratégicos que conectam tecnologia, governança e resultados. Para fortalecer nosso time,

buscamos um Desenvolvedor ServiceNow com experiência sólida em SPM (Strategic

Portfolio Management) e profundo domínio em Change Velocity / DevOps Change

Velocity.


Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver, configurar e evoluir soluções no módulo SPM, com foco em Change Velocity, Demand, Project, Portfolio e Resource Management.
  • Implementar fluxos e automações para avaliação, priorização, aprovação e monitoramento de demandas e projetos.
  • Criar dashboards, relatórios executivos e métricas avançadas de fluxo (lead time, throughput, WIP, capacidade).
  • Integrar o ServiceNow com ferramentas DevOps e de gestão de projetos (Jenkins, Git, Azure DevOps, Jira).
  • Automatizar pipelines, orquestrar mudanças e garantir visibilidade ponta a ponta do ciclo de entrega.
  • Sustentar e evoluir a solução com foco em governança, performance e boas práticas ServiceNow.


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência comprovada (mínimo 2 anos) com o módulo DevOps Change Velocity do ServiceNow.
  • Vivência prática com os módulos SPM, Change Velocity, automações e integrações DevOps.

  • Experiência com ITSM (Incident, Problem, Change), ITIL e automação de pipelines.
  • Integrações com Jenkins, Git, Azure DevOps, Jira e demais ferramentas de entrega contínua.


Diferenciais


  • Certificações ServiceNow (CSA, CIS-SPM, CIS-DevOps, CAD).

title: Senior Front-end Engineer (Browser Extension)
description:
We are looking for a remote Senior Front-end Engineer (Browser Extension) to develop and publish Chrome extensions for our U.S. client. The duration of this project will last 3-6 months with the opportunity to extend into a full-time position.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively implement formal security and privacy programs, measure the effectiveness of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-quality Chrome extensions that meet product and user requirements
  • Integrate Chrome Extension APIs to create seamless user experiences and efficient browser functionality
  • Collaborate with designers and back-end developers to ensure smooth data flow and consistent UI/UX
  • Debug, test, and optimize extensions for performance, compatibility, and scalability
  • Manage the full lifecycle of Chrome extensions, including publishing, version control, and updates in the Chrome Web Store
  • Stay current with evolving Chrome APIs and web development best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 5+ years of proven experience developing and publishing Chrome extensions
  • Solid understanding of Chrome Extension architecture and APIs (e.g., Manifest v3, background scripts, content scripts, messaging, and permissions)
  • Experience building interactive front-end components with .js
  • Proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
  • Ability to write clean, modular, and maintainable code
  • Familiarity with version control (e.g., Git) and modern web development workflows
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in computer science, engineering, or related field
  • Experience with Node.js


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Administrative Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $800 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,600 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary:


The Administrative Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support, helping to coordinate schedules, maintain communication with internal and external teams, and manage tasks in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and proactive, supporting the client in a variety of tasks to ensure smooth daily operations.


Job Tasks:


  • Calendar Management: Organize schedules, book meetings, and keep calendars up to date.
  • Email Management: Review, prioritize, and organize emails professionally.
  • Task Tracking: Monitor tasks and deadlines using project management tools.
  • Documentation: Prepare reports, take meeting notes, and maintain organized digital files.
  • Customer Support: Communicate with clients and teams via email, chat, and phone as needed.
  • Research Assistance: Support with gathering information and summarizing findings when required.
  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • WhatsApp
  • Asana
  • Miro
  • Canva
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

title: Email Marketing Manager
description:
Email Marketing Manager

As the Email Marketing Manager, you are a detail-oriented, hard-working problem solver with an optimistic attitude that can easily (and happily) wear many hats. You can uphold our company’s principles and values while adding to our unique culture.


As a member of our Marketing Team, you will broadly be responsible for multi-channel performance-based marketing. This is a strategic and executional role - we need someone who brings a wealth of domain expertise, gets the big picture, rolls up their sleeves and manages campaigns themselves. You’re an authority in leading and optimizing outbound campaigns and have experience delivering results at scale.


You are a strategic and results-driven marketer who’s particularly energized by outbound marketing and is deeply familiar with how technology and platforms enable multi-channel communications. You have experience personalizing and scaling customer-facing communications and workflows using marketing automation, deep qualitative and quantitative insights, and iterative experimentation to drive profound business impact and seamless, integrated customer experiences. If this sounds like you, join our growing team.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and manage all automated email campaigns and multi-channel workflows personalized or specifically targeted by customer segments where possible.
  • Develop and execute impactful communication campaigns informed by a test-and-learn approach, rigorous quantitative analysis, insights from market research, and overarching business goals.
  • Define the ideal consumer profile and plan to collect, grow, and segment data further over time.
  • Build the project roadmap and communication calendar for the email channel, launch and monitor direct response campaigns, and manage the developing tracking and reporting infrastructure.
  • Develop a systematic A/B split testing process to maximize user engagement and nurture customer acquisition.
  • Collaborate with other channel owners to ensure consistent messaging across all performance marketing mediums.
  • Be the main liaison with Salesforce Admin team members.
  • Own social media marketing management via HubSpot.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in email marketing strategy, execution, optimization, and reporting cycle.
  • 3+ years of experience in using CRM and marketing automation tools (HubSpot experience preferred).
  • Strong analytical skills with a passion for experimenting via split tests.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Excellent leadership skills with the confidence to lead, influence, engage and partner with cross-functional partners to drive business results.
  • Thrives in a fluid, fast-paced and results-oriented environment; able to adapt to changing business needs and influence decision-making across all levels of the organization.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing or associated studies.
  • C1 or C2 English proficiency level.

title: Instructional Designer
description:
ADP is hiring a Learning Design Consultant (Instructional Designer).


In this role, you will focus primarily on applying efficient and agile design approaches to develop innovative, engaging learning solutions, using ADP learning design standards and tools, to meet the learning needs of ADP associates and clients.


No two days are the same. You will do everything from creating design documents, testing and deploying content, conducting needs assessments across multiple business lines, establishing training plans, overseeing translations, measuring results, and more. You will do this all to the highest standards with an eye on appealing to multi-generational talent and the modern learner and by partnering across the learning organization to apply innovative techniques in instructional design. You can create compelling content and convey ideas and information to many levels of an organization.


To thrive in the role, you have 3+ years of experience in the learning - development field. You have worked independently to design and develop sound training in various modalities, i.e., eLearning, instructor-led, blended, job aids, and more, and can manage simultaneous projects with deadlines. It would be best to be a continuous learner who focuses on personal development and business process improvement to our design standards. Your work will help our businesses support our clients who employ one to millions of employees.


Like what you see? Apply now!


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Innovation : You seek opportunities to apply innovative design thinking to your projects and will work to keep ADP's approach to designing learning up to date with the products and solutions ADP offers its clients.
  • Flexibility and Agility : You can adapt to changing business requirements, projects, and resources and use agile approaches to meet business needs.
  • Design: You'll design holistic solutions engaging team members and business partners in the design process to ensure the solution design is flexible and addresses the unique needs of the learners. Solution design should consider and factor in how the work environment impacts learning.
  • Development: You can develop solutions across a broad set of learning modalities and tools without creating redundant solutions and ensure that continuous learning and performance support concepts are applied.
  • Learning Outcomes: You measure your outcomes and ensure your learning solutions result in the intended business impact.
  • Continuous Learner: You focus on personal development to develop and elevate professional knowledge and skill. You take the same approach to business process improvement to improve ADP learning design standards and drive the adoption of those standards. You maintain an outside-in perspective by building and maintaining peer networks inside and outside ADP.


TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

A college degree is not required but could set you apart. What's more important is having the skills and experience to do the job. You will need 3+ years of experience in instructional development, adult learning theory, and/or technical writing.

Other things that will set you apart:

  • Experience using eLearning tools such as Captivate, Articulate 360 , Synthesia, TechSmith Camtasia , TechSmith SnagIt, Audacity, and Vyond. Technical aptitude to quickly learn new development tools.
  • Experience using a Learning Management System (i.e., Litmos)
  • Experience with simple Graphic Design


Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in the learning and development field
  • Ability to systematically design, develop, and implement learning content that meets specific organizational needs
  • Skilled in building learning solutions for English-speaking audiences
  • Proficient in Articulate Storyline, Rise, Synthesia, or similar authoring tools
  • Working knowledge of Learning Management Systems (upload/manage content, apply technical standards, etc.)
  • Proven success collaborating virtually


YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Collaborate. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and respect one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner - doer. Mission-driven and committed to navigating change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.


Learn more here:

What are you waiting for? Apply now!

title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.

Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Marketing Coordinator to join our growing team!


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!


About You


  • Highly motivated and passionate about delivering excellent work
  • Proactive, always anticipating potential challenges and crafting solutions
  • Strong communicator, ensuring clarity with both internal teams and clients
  • Professional level of English (written and spoken)
  • Friendly, respectful, and able to work effectively within a team
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and resourceful—you find answers when needed and make sure things are running smoothly
  • You’re a people person and love finding ways to solve problems with creative ideas
  • Excellent time management and ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously
  • You love talking through ideas, offering feedback, and helping teams align with client goals
  • A background in marketing is essential
  • Nerdiness is a bonus! If you love D&D, Pokémon, video games, or books, we’ll get along just fine!


Purpose of the Role


The Marketing Coordinator role combines project coordination with client relationship management, acting as a bridge between internal teams and clients. This role supports smooth project execution by managing internal communication, task coordination, and ensuring that all client deliverables are met on time, within budget, and to the highest standard. You'll be integral in managing both the marketing efforts and client interactions, translating client goals into actionable tasks, and ensuring the process runs seamlessly from start to finish.


Main Objectives


1-Client Collaboration & Project Oversight:

  • Collaborate with clients to understand their marketing goals and expectations.
  • Translate these goals into clear tasks for the Marketing Coordinator, ensuring smooth project execution.
  • Regularly meet with clients to review deliverables, adjust timelines, and maintain strong relationships.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, providing updates, addressing concerns, and ensuring satisfaction.


2-Internal Team Coordination:

  • Work closely with designers, copywriters, media buyers, and other team members to develop high-quality marketing materials across all service offerings.
  • Organize internal kick-off meetings, assign tasks, and ensure that everything stays on schedule and within scope.
  • Provide clear direction and thoughtful feedback to internal teams to ensure work meets or exceeds client expectations.
  • Ensure all project management tools (Asana, Trello, ClickUp) and Teamwork boards are up to date.


3-Communication & Task Management:

  • Manage meetings with clients, ensuring clear action plans and next steps.
  • Review and approve final deliverables before submission, making sure they meet client goals and expectations.
  • Use tools like Jiminny to document meetings, share important notes, and ensure all action items are tracked.
  • Keep all teams aligned through regular check-ins and updates, making sure deadlines are met and no tasks fall through the cracks.


4-Resource Planning & Problem Solving:

  • Manage multiple projects at once, ensuring each one is progressing smoothly, with no delays or miscommunication.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues, whether they relate to resources, deadlines, or client feedback.
  • Proactively anticipate problems and find creative solutions to keep projects on track.


5-Strategic & Process-Oriented Thinking:

  • Help shape the big-picture marketing strategy with the Senior

title: Junior Python Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Python Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Create data integration services to help onboard new customers as quickly as possible.

- Maintain ongoing reliability, performance, and support of the data infrastructure, providing solutions based on application needs and anticipated growth.


Requirements:


- 1+ years of practical experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience in development with object-oriented programming is desirable.

- 1 year of development using other programming languages.

- Good skills with XML and relational databases (Oracle / MS SQL / MySQL).

- Strong professional experience working with large data structures (including XML) and algorithms.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Search Engine Marketing Strategist
description:
Estratégista de Marketing de Busca (Search Engine Marketing Strategist) WPP Media Studio – Divisão de E-Commerce

Meio período · Trabalho remoto

Uma Marca Fundada em Inovação, Confiança e Crescimento Sustentável

Na WPP Media Studio , acreditamos no poder do marketing digital para gerar conexões reais e duradouras. Nosso compromisso com a excelência e inovação nos permite ajudar marcas globais a alcançar seus objetivos, maximizando o impacto e a relevância no mundo digital.

Com uma visão focada em estratégias de longo prazo e baseadas em dados, somos movidos pelo propósito de oferecer soluções eficazes e resultados consistentes. Nossa missão é criar experiências digitais que transformam marcas e conectam empresas com seus consumidores de maneira significativa.

Agora, para fortalecer nossa equipe de marketing digital, estamos em busca de um Estratégista de Marketing de Busca (SEM) altamente qualificado. Se você é uma pessoa apaixonada por resultados, com uma visão estratégica e foco em performance, queremos que você se junte a nós para construir o futuro do marketing de busca e e-commerce.

Por que esta função é importante?

O marketing de busca é uma das pedras angulares das estratégias de marketing digital, especialmente no e-commerce. Como Estratégista de Marketing de Busca , você será responsável por desenvolver e implementar estratégias de SEM (Search Engine Marketing) que impulsionam o tráfego, aumentam a visibilidade da marca e, acima de tudo, geram conversões para nossos clientes.

Esta função é essencial porque:

  • Impulsiona a visibilidade digital e o tráfego qualificado para as marcas com as quais trabalhamos
  • Maximiza o ROI (Retorno sobre o Investimento) de campanhas de mídia paga através de otimizações contínuas
  • Gerencia e executa campanhas de Google Ads, Bing Ads e outras plataformas de busca , garantindo máxima eficiência
  • Contribui diretamente para a estratégia de e-commerce , gerando resultados tangíveis e mensuráveis

Seu trabalho terá um impacto direto no crescimento e no sucesso contínuo de nossos clientes no universo digital.

Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolvimento e Execução de Estratégias SEM

  • Criar estratégias eficazes para campanhas de Google Ads , Bing Ads e outras plataformas de busca
  • Gerenciar a execução e otimização de campanhas de SEM, focando em aquisição de tráfego e conversões
  • Realizar pesquisa de palavras-chave , análise da concorrência e monitoramento de tendências de mercado

Otimização de Desempenho

  • Monitorar e otimizar continuamente campanhas com o objetivo de melhorar o CPC (Custo por Clique) , CTR (Taxa de Clique) e ROI (Retorno sobre o Investimento)
  • Utilizar dados de Google Analytics e outras ferramentas analíticas para avaliar o desempenho das campanhas
  • Conduzir testes A/B para aprimorar a performance das campanhas e o conteúdo dos anúncios

Análise e Relatórios

  • Preparar relatórios detalhados sobre o desempenho das campanhas e fornecer insights acionáveis aos clientes
  • Traduzir dados e métricas de desempenho em recomendações claras para ajustes nas campanhas
  • Monitorar a configuração de pixels de rastreamento , ações de conversão e outras métricas relevantes

Colaboração e Comunicação

  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com as equipes de criatividade , conteúdo e e-commerce para garantir a consistência da marca e a eficácia das campanhas
  • Manter uma comunicação aberta com os clientes, fornecendo atualizações regulares sobre o progresso das campanhas
Qualificações Necessárias
  • Experiência comprovada em marketing de busca com foco em Google Ads e Bing Ads
  • Sólido conhecimento de SEO (Search Engine Optimization) e SEM (Search Engine Marketing)
  • Experiência com Google Analytics e outras ferramentas de monitoramento de desempenho
  • Habilidade para interpretar dados e fazer ajustes para melhorar resultados de campanhas
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas campanhas simultaneamente com um alto nível de precisão e atenção aos detalhes
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação e relacionamento com clientes
  • Trabalho remoto com autonomia e alta responsabilidade
Experiência Preferencial

(Não obrigatória, mas será um diferencial)

  • Experiência com plataformas de publicidade programática e remarketing
  • Certificações avançadas em Google Ads e Microsoft Advertising
  • Conhecimento de otimização da taxa de conversão (CRO) e criação de páginas de destino eficazes
  • Experiência no mercado de e-commerce e em campanhas digitais que geram receita
Benefícios e Cultura de Trabalho

Na WPP Media Studio , nossa cultura se baseia na confiança, transparência e no trabalho em equipe. Acreditamos que nossos colaboradores devem ter o espaço e a flexibilidade para prosperar. Oferecemos:

  • Trabalho remoto flexível : você poderá trabalhar de qualquer lugar, com horários flexíveis
  • Crescimento profissional contínuo : oportunidades para aprimorar suas habilidades e influenciar a estratégia de marketing digital
  • Ambiente colaborativo : uma equipe dinâmica e engajada que trabalha com sinergia para alcançar os melhores resultados
  • Foco no impacto : trabalhamos para gerar valor real para nossos clientes e construir parcerias de longo prazo
  • Cultura missionária : nosso compromisso é sempre com a qualidade, inovação e resultados sustentáveis
  • Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, o desenvolvimento contínuo e o impacto real que nossos colaboradores fazem na transformação digital de nossos clientes.

title: Customer Service Specialist
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Customer Service Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $840-$$1,400 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,680-$2,800 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10,5 - $17,5 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary :


The Customer Service Specialist will be responsible for providing exceptional customer support, resolving inquiries and complaints, managing customer accounts, and ensuring a positive customer experience across all communication channels.


Job Tasks :


  • Customer Support: Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and social media in a timely and professional manner.
  • Problem Resolution: Identify customer issues, troubleshoot problems, and provide effective solutions or escalate when necessary.

title: Senior Clinical Data Science Programmer
description:
Senior Clinical Data Science Programmer - Remote - Brazil


ICON plc is a world-leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organization. We’re proud to foster an inclusive environment driving innovation and excellence, and we welcome you to join us on our mission to shape the future of clinical development


We are currently seeking a Senior Clinical Data Science Programmer to join our diverse and dynamic team. As a Senior Clinical Data Science Programmer at ICON, you will play a pivotal role in developing and implementing programming solutions to support the analysis and reporting of clinical trial data. You will contribute to the advancement of innovative treatments and therapies by ensuring the accuracy and efficiency of data processing through your programming expertise.


What You Will Be Doing:

  • Develop, validate, and maintain programming solutions for CDMS (EDC systems such as Rave/Veeva), data validation outputs, data review/risk management outputs, custom reports, and programs in clinical trials.
  • Collaborate with data managers, project managers, clinical data scientists, and biostatisticians to ensure the integration of programming solutions into the overall data management process.
  • Act as a primary point of contact during the study set up and maintenance phase for system programming related questions by the project team.
  • Support colleagues with the clinical trials environment and concepts of Clinical Data Management Systems.
  • Perform extracts of data from CDMS and creation of data
